{{Top}}
{{Quote|Horizontal boosters&hellip;! Alluvial dampers&hellip;! Well that's not it. Bring me the hydrospanners!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''horizontal booster''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] subsystem. It provided energy to the ionization chamber to facilitate ignition.
